label: Screencast / Browser Frame
description: THE component for presenting real screen recordings (or screenshots) -- never hand-roll a browser mock around a <video>. Renders the footage in a polished device frame: frame_style 'macos-browser' draws a mac window bar (traffic lights + address pill), 'plain' is a clean rounded card, 'none' is edge-to-edge. crop:'auto' reads the footage's ingest analysis and crops any window chrome the RECORDING ITSELF contains (a screencast of a full browser window carries its own address bar -- framing it without cropping shows two stacked headers).

crop.label: Source crop: 'auto' (recommended -- uses ingest analysis) or {top,bottom,left,right} in SOURCE pixels

max_width_pct.label: Frame width as % of the component box
